title: El Estado moderno
goal: Read a closing synthesis of how institutional strengthening, cultural nationalism, education, and territorial integration advanced together to produce a categorically different, modern Latin American state.
grammar: A medida que: procesos que avanzan juntos

items: Explain how the meaning of "Estado" transformed across these decades.
State what the state stopped depending on as armies professionalized.
Explain what happened to the everyday experience of citizenship as state reach expanded.
Describe how the late-1930s state compared to the fragile nineteenth-century state.
Use a medida que to link two processes advancing together.
